# [TASK] Implement Azure & AWS Compute Start/Stop and Inactivity Watchdog Scripts

## Task
Add start/stop compute scripts and 1-hour inactivity auto-stop watchdog for Azure AKS and AWS EC2 (k3s) along with Gradle deployment tasks.

## Parent Story
Parent: #156

## Scope
- `infrastructure/scripts/start-azure.sh` and `stop-azure.sh`
- `infrastructure/scripts/start-aws.sh` and `stop-aws.sh`
- `infrastructure/scripts/auto-stop-watchdog.sh`
- Gradle tasks in root `build.gradle`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Azure start/stop scripts resume and pause AKS compute nodes without destroying state.
- [x] AWS start/stop scripts resume and pause EC2 k3s instance without destroying state.
- [x] Auto-stop watchdog script checks `/actuator/activity` and stops compute if idle >= 3600s.
- [x] Gradle tasks (`startAzure`, `stopAzure`, `startAws`, `stopAws`, `autoStopWatchdog`) registered.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3
